implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 31 HDL source files (5 systemverilog, 24 verilog, 2 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this openFPGA core ships 2 MRA files of its own; 2 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation, giving 2 distinct machine_id rows. License: https://github.com/opengateware/arcade-bankp/blob/master/rtl/bankpanic.v carries the tag SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later -- read from the repository, not inferred; https://github.com/opengateware/arcade-bankp/blob/master/LICENSE is the matching licence text. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 31 source files (5 systemverilog, 24 verilog, 2 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest pkg/pocket/Cores/boogermann.bankpanic/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier boogermann.bankpanic.
